body: The owner confirmed the rule at 06:18 PDT: popularity means units produced (collector tallies are fine, say which figure), and a popular game is not deferred because it needs a shared system first; the system is built first. For VectorCraft that opens Tempest and Battlezone beside Star Castle, with the 3D pipeline ahead of them. Apply the same to the Williams list: rank by units produced, open the top three, and build what they need first.
summary: Owner confirmed: popularity = units produced, 3D/hardest-engine games not deferred
